description: Land Acquisition - Kowana, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing multiple parcels of land being acquired for public purposes (Central Expressway Project). It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, extents, locations, and claimant information, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property matters.
